summary.text: Suzanne Johnson is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 151 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong vegan and artist and said her priorities include animal rights, disability rights and the rights of senior citizens.

paragraphs.text: Johnson advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
In the survey, she said she is a single parent of two and a descendant of families who lived in southern Maine and New Hampshire since the 1600s.
She said she would work for laws ending the importation of animals into Maine for hunting and for stronger enforcement of disability rights.
